title: Chapter 27 The Last Day
content:
Chapter 27 The Last Day

On October 9, the 22nd year of the Qin Dynasty, there was only one day left before the ten-day competition. At the South Gate School Ground of Anlu County, the long cypress trees in Jiashi were restless.

That day, he just had the mentality of giving it a try, and went to stimulate Hei Fu. If Hei Fu was afraid of rejection, he could just laugh at it.

Who would have expected that this idiot from the countryside would agree to it! He also made such a big bet! Now the face-saving Yuan Bai had no way out and had no choice but to accept the move.

But thinking about it afterwards, he still felt that he could definitely win. In his opinion, Heifu, a 17-year-old soldier who was serving for the first time, could lead Quan Shiyong to win the first place in the assessment? Yuan Baike didn't believe this would happen at all.

He had already planned that as long as this black man couldn't get the first place, he would be disgraced and have to work as a tenant farmer for two years for nothing, so he would have to exploit him.

At that time, Guishi's training was indeed stagnant and his morale was low. But Yuan Bai never expected that in just four or five days, Guishi would undergo earth-shaking changes!

First of all, the training progress is different from standing, squatting, and turning left and right in the same place in the first few days. On October 6th, everyone in Guishi finally began to walk around the school grounds and practice "walking and stopping". Their practice method was still so unique: those people did not wear shoes on their left feet, and one high Walking low, don't mention how funny it is.

This funny scene caused everyone in Jiashi to laugh, but on October 7th, they couldn't laugh anymore...

It turned out that relying on the good foundation laid in the previous few days and after a day of practice, everyone in Guishi was able to step on the right foot without taking off their left shoes. Once someone stepped wrong, the five commander Dongmen Leopard who followed behind He would step forward and give him a hard slap with the bamboo stick in his hand!

Shi Changheifu walked in front holding a thick bamboo pole. As he walked, he shouted "left, right, left, left, left, left". The people behind him followed his footsteps and shouted the same words.

On the eighth day, Guishi's marching queue became more regular. They could already shout left and right while jogging, and kept moving at the same rhythm. Everyone moved like the left and right legs of a centipede, looking very regular.

When Heifu shouted to stop, everyone stopped, raised their right feet, and stepped heavily on the ground. The sound of stomping feet made Yuan Bai tremble.

Of course he didn't know that the reason why everyone in Guishi was able to maintain high morale was thanks to his four thousand dollars, which Hei Fu treated as a picture cake in front of everyone. After receiving Heifu's promise to "share the money", even the three people who were the most passive in training, Ping, Ke and Bu, began to work hard to keep up with the team's rhythm.

Drive it away with profit, tie it with righteousness, push it with kindness, and threaten it with law... Heifu skillfully used these methods, and with the help of Ji Ying and Dongmen Bao, he turned what was originally like a plate of loose sand. The whole thing is gathered together.

"If this continues, Guishi might really get the first place..." Yuan Bai began to panic. Although his family was wealthy, four thousand dollars was not a small amount after all.

"Sir, I have an idea."

The team leader of Jiashi came over and said in Yuan Bai's ear: "I and Xiao Tao of Guishi are from the same hometown. This boy stutters, his family is poor, and he is cowardly and can be bullied. As long as he threatens him a little, he can be bullied." Promise him some money and let him deliberately lag behind in the ten-day competition, so Guishi won't be able to get first place!"

"That's great!" Yuan Bai's eyes lit up and he asked Captain Jia Shi to find a way to find Xiao Tao quickly.

Therefore, during the meal of the day, when Xiao Tao went to the toilet alone, he was blocked outside Muxuan by three or four people including Yuan Bai and Wu Zhang from Jia Shi...

…

Just like what Captain Jiashi said, Xiao Tao was a thin and short young man. He was forced to tremble in the corner by everyone. Yuan Bai stepped forward with a smile and began to intimidate and lure him...

"me……"

After Yuan Bai explained his intention, Xiao Tao's face turned red and he was almost speechless. He didn't know whether he was angry or scared.

"Just take it!"

Yuan Bai forced the cloth bag containing one hundred coins into Xiao Tao's hands, put his arm around his shoulders and promised: "If you can do what I said and fall behind on purpose during the competition tomorrow, I will I’ll give you another hundred dollars!”

Captain Jiash also clenched his fists and threatened: "Otherwise, when I return to the countryside, I will have your good harvest!"

Xiao Tao's eyes were full of fear, and he looked at the money in his hand at a loss.

His family was poor, and his mother contracted leprosy. She was caught by neighbors in the countryside, sentenced to death, and drowned by the river. His father was cowardly and incompetent, and did not dare to say a word about this matter. The brothers and sisters in the family had already been married, and the families were divided, and no one cared about him.

Throughout the year, Xiao Tao and his hunched father had to work on the less than 100 acres of thin farmland at home, just to earn a little harvest to survive. All told, Xiao Tao has never had so much money in his hands since he was a child!

He opened the money bag with trembling hands and looked at the round and square coins inside. They were full of attractive metallic luster. They were stacked on top of each other and made a pleasant sound...

Yuan Bai looked at Xiao Tao with a triumphant smile under his beard. He felt that this son had fallen into the eyes of money and this could be done. Even though Heifu brought Guishi into strict order beyond everyone's expectations, no matter how beautiful the orange is on the outside, it will become rotten from the inside.

However, what happened next was beyond Yuan Bai's expectation.

"But Shichang... treats me... not too lightly."

Xiao Tao opened his mouth, murmured these words, then suddenly raised his money bag high and threw all the money to the ground!

"Wow!"

Coins fell all over the ground, like a rain of money.

"You..." Yuan Bai took half a step back in surprise.

Xiao Tao's face lifted up, and it was then that Yuan Bai and others discovered that his flushed face was not excitement, but humiliation; his trembling hands were not fear, but anger!

The shy young man from Yunmeng Township was so humiliated and angry, he stammered and said word by word: "You... don't... look down on me, look down on me!"

Under the shocked gazes of Yuan Bai and others, Xiao Tao raised his head and raised his chest, just like Heifu taught them, with his weak body, he stood up like a straight green pine!

"I...I...I will never...betray...Shi Chang!"

"You little brat! You don't know what's good and what's good!" Yuan Bai and others were furious and raised their fists to fight!

Although Xiao Tao was very tough with his words, he was still a little scared. He closed his eyes tightly and protected his head.

But after waiting for a long time, Yuan Bai's fist did not fall.

When Xiao Tao opened his eyes, he found that Yuan Bai's wrist was tightly pinched by a thick hand. It was Guishi, the tallest and strongest man. He was glaring at Yuan Bai with a cold eyebrow.

The other three members of Jia Shi were also stopped by Ji Ying and Zhi who came over.

Heifu appeared behind them, playing with the dagger in his hand, and said with a sneer: "Shichang Yuanbai, what do you mean by this? You don't know how to do it, so you want to be cunning? You know, this is a private fight, If you are not straight, if the official temple finds out, you will be convicted!"

"Misunderstanding, misunderstanding..." Yuan Bai's hands were about to be crushed, and he begged for mercy with a twisted face.

Heifu didn't want to make the matter a big deal, so he waved his hand and asked Mu to let go of Yuan Bai.

"Yuan Baishi, walk slowly. After tomorrow's competition, don't forget the agreement between you and me!" Heifu looked at the figures of these people running away in confusion and waved to them.

Finally, he turned around and looked at Xiao Tao, who was hanging his head and said nothing for a long time.

"What the hell...I..."

It wasn't until Xiao Tao raised his head and tried to explain that Hei Fu smiled happily, patted his shoulder heavily and said, "Well done!"

…

"It's such a big deal, why didn't you call me? If I had been here at that time, I would have removed one of Yuan Bai's arms!"

When everyone returned to the school grounds, Dongmen Bao knew what had happened. He immediately cried out his regrets, rolled up his sleeves and was about to go to Jia Shi to trouble Yuan Bai.

"If you beat him up and we get first place tomorrow, where can we find four thousand dollars?"

Heifu quickly held him down. Just then, the clever Ji Ying discovered that Jia Shi's people blocked Xiao Tao and immediately came to inform him. Hei Fu deliberately did not take Dongmen Leopard with him. This reckless man did not know the importance of his actions. Who knows what trouble he will cause.

It is commendable that Xiao Tao finally withstood the coercion and inducement, which impressed Hei Fu. On the way back, Hei Fu kept praising this stuttering young man from the country, saying that he was not afraid of rape and was a good man who was unyielding. The shy little Tao blushed.

However, this incident also sounded the alarm for Heifu. He decided to train quickly in the next day and never let anyone leave the team alone and let others take advantage of the opportunity.

After these days of training, Guishi's formation has made great progress, although turning left and right on the same spot is still a bit awkward, and mistakes are made from time to time. But the standing posture, marching in the team, squatting to stand up, and striding back and turning have already reached the standards required by Heifu. Although it will definitely be at the bottom in future university military training, but in the chaotic pace of the more soldiers, it has already reached the standard required by Heifu. It stands out from the crowd.

Heifu is even more confident about taking the lead tomorrow!

But it was not enough. Before sunset that day, after everyone else had finished their training and went to eat, Heifu gathered everyone in Guishi together again. Looking at their faces of different ages, everyone stood up straight and looked at each other. What are their strengths.

At this moment, Heifu felt a lot of emotion, as if he had really returned to the scene before the review on the last day of military training in his previous life.

After being silent for a long time, he slowly said:

"Today is the last day before the competition, the last training. Whether it is sitting up, walking and stopping, left and right, front and back, you have already mastered it by heart, and it is of no use to review it again. But Here, I have to teach you one last thing!"
